question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Intent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. uncertain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intent"** means having a purpose or goal in mind; being resolved or determined to do something. (इरादा)

 
 
• **Example: **She was intent on finishing her project before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **"Uncertain" **refers to something that is not known or definite; it indicates doubt or lack of sureness. (अनिश्चित)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt uncertain about the outcome of his job interview.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'intent' **is **'uncertain'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. uncertain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rigid** (कठोर): Not flexible or pliable; unable to be changed.

 
 
• **Example:** The rules of the competition were rigid and non-negotiable.
 
 
 
• **Involved** (लिप्त): Complicated or intricate; engaged or participating in something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was deeply involved in the community outreach program.
 
 
 
• **Alert** (चौकस): Fully aware and attentive; quick to notice any unusual or potential danger.
 
 
• **Example:** The guard remained alert throughout the night.
